name: Scoped To Compliance Boundary
description: A system component is in scope for a compliance authorization boundary. The component is the source (wildcard); the boundary is the target. 'Everything inside boundary X' is a fan-in query over edges whose target is X.

kludge.description: V0 auto-membership marker: names the placeholder rule that enrolled this member (currently 'all-aws-accounts-auto-in-boundary-v0', written by samsite's compliance collector). Deliberately still named kludge — the real boundary-membership design (which accounts, who declares, where the rule lives) is an Open Question in the aws_core spec; this field becomes membership_rule when that design lands. Optional so hand-authored membership edges need no marker.
